title: "PBF Summary Report"

  data_list: NA
  pbf_column: "PBF"

# Physical and Biological Features of Critical Habitat

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(officer)
library(knitr)

# Identify the target column passed from Shiny
target_col <- params$pbf_column

# --- 1. CLEAN STRESSOR NAMES FOR DISPLAY ---
clean_stressor_name <- function(st_name) {
  if (is.null(st_name) || st_name == "") return("")
  st_clean <- gsub("_", " ", st_name)
  paste0(toupper(substr(st_clean, 1, 1)), tolower(substr(st_clean, 2, nchar(st_clean))))
}

# --- 2. SCIENTIFIC TAXA LIBRARY & WORD-LEVEL ITALIC PARSER ---
scientific_genera <- c(
  "Acropora", "Fimbriaphyllia", "Isopora", "Orbicella", "Pocillopora", "Porites", "Siderastrea",
  "Sargassum", "Halophila", "Zostera", "Phyllospadix", "Rhizophora", "Pristis", "Ammodytes",
  "Euphausia", "Thysanoessa", "Nematoscelis", "Nyctiphanes", "Aurelia", "Chrysaora", "Cyanea",
  "Clupea", "Engraulis", "Gadus", "Mallotus", "Sardinops", "Phacellophora", "Semaeostomeae",
  "Alariaceae", "Chordaceae", "Costariaceae", "Laminaricea", "Lessoniacea"
)

non_italic_descriptors <- c("Coral", "habitat", "in", "community", "waters", "and", "for", "or", "DPS", "ESU", "species", "area", "areas")

format_species_paragraph <- function(cell_text) {
  if (is.na(cell_text) || cell_text == "") {
    return(as_paragraph(as_chunk("")))
  }
  
  lines <- unlist(strsplit(cell_text, "
"))
  chunk_list <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(lines)) {
    line <- lines[i]
    is_last <- (i == length(lines))
    nl <- if (is_last) "" else "
"
    
    m <- regexec("^([A-Z][a-z]+)(\\s+([A-Z][a-z]+|[a-z]+))?", line)
    matches <- regmatches(line, m)[[1]]
    
    if (length(matches) >= 2 && matches[2] %in% scientific_genera) {
      genus <- matches[2]
      second_word <- if (length(matches) >= 4) matches[4] else ""
      
      if (nchar(second_word) > 0 && !(second_word %in% non_italic_descriptors)) {
        sci <- paste(genus, second_word)
      } else {
        sci <- genus
      }
      
      rest <- paste0(substring(line, nchar(sci) + 1), nl)
      
      chunk_list[[length(chunk_list) + 1]] <- as_chunk(
        sci, 
        props = fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 10, italic = TRUE)
      )
      if (nchar(rest) > 0) {
        chunk_list[[length(chunk_list) + 1]] <- as_chunk(
          rest, 
          props = fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 10, italic = FALSE)
        )
      }
    } else {
      chunk_list[[length(chunk_list) + 1]] <- as_chunk(
        paste0(line, nl), 
        props = fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 10, italic = FALSE)
      )
    }
  }
  
  do.call(as_paragraph, chunk_list)
}

# Applies precise word-level italics to flextable column
apply_scientific_italics_column <- function(ft, j_col) {
  col_name <- colnames(ft$body$dataset)[j_col]
  cell_values <- ft$body$dataset[[col_name]]
  
  for (r in seq_along(cell_values)) {
    p <- format_species_paragraph(cell_values[r])
    ft <- mk_par(ft, i = r, j = j_col, value = p)
  }
  ft
}

# --- 3. HELPER FUNCTION: GROUP & SORT SPECIES NAMES ---
format_species_group <- function(spp_vector) {
  spp_clean <- sort(unique(spp_vector))
  
  base_names <- sub("^([^–—-]+)\\s*[–—-]\\s*(.*)$", "\\1", spp_clean)
  esu_dps    <- ifelse(grepl("[–—-]", spp_clean),
                       sub("^([^–—-]+)\\s*[–—-]\\s*(.*)$", "\\2", spp_clean),
                       "")
  
  df_spp <- data.frame(
    base = trimws(base_names),
    esu  = trimws(esu_dps),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  res <- df_spp %>%
    group_by(base) %>%
    summarise(
      formatted = case_when(
        all(esu == "") ~ first(base),
        n() == 1      ~ paste0(first(base), " \u2013 ", first(esu)),
        TRUE          ~ paste0(first(base), " \u2013 ", paste(esu[esu != ""], collapse = ", "))
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(base)
  
  paste(res$formatted, collapse = "
")
}

# --- 4. SPECIES SUMMARY FORMAT ---
render_species_summary <- function(df) {
  cap_title <- "Physical and biological features of critical habitat by species"
  
  ft <- df %>%
    mutate(PBF_category = ifelse(is.na(PBF_category) | PBF_category == "", "", PBF_category)) %>%
    group_by(Species, PBF_category) %>%
    summarise(
      pbf_list = paste0("  \u2022 ", unique(.data[[target_col]]), collapse = "
"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(category_block = if_else(PBF_category == "",
                                   pbf_list,
                                   paste0(PBF_category, ":
", pbf_list))) %>%
    group_by(Species) %>%
    summarise(
      pbf_text = paste(category_block, collapse = "

"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(pbf_text) %>%
    summarise(
      'Species (ESU/DPS)' = format_species_group(Species),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(`Species (ESU/DPS)`) %>%
    rename('Physical and biological features' = pbf_text) %>%
    select('Species (ESU/DPS)', 'Physical and biological features') %>%
    flextable() %>%
    theme_vanilla() %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 2.2) %>%
    width(j = 2, width = 4.3) %>%
    valign(valign = "top", part = "all") %>%
    font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
    fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
    bold(part = "header") %>%
    border_inner_h(border = fp_border(color="gray80", width = 1)) %>%
    set_caption(
      caption = as_paragraph(
        as_chunk(cap_title, props = fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 12, bold = TRUE))
      ),
      style = "Normal",
      fp_p = fp_par(text.align = "left")
    )
  
  apply_scientific_italics_column(ft, 1)
}

# --- 5. STRESSOR & OTHERS FORMAT ---
format_st_table <- function(df, st_title) {
  cap_text <- paste0("Physical and biological features associated with ", clean_stressor_name(st_title))
  
  ft <- df %>%
    mutate(PBF_category = ifelse(is.na(PBF_category) | PBF_category == "", "", PBF_category)) %>%
    group_by(PBF_category, .data[[target_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      Species_List = format_species_group(Species),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(PBF_Display = if_else(PBF_category == "",
                                .data[[target_col]],
                                paste0(PBF_category, ": ", .data[[target_col]]))) %>%
    select('Physical and biological feature' = PBF_Display,
           'Associated species' = Species_List) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    theme_vanilla() %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 3.5) %>%
    width(j = 2, width = 3.0) %>%
    valign(valign = "top", part = "all") %>%
    font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
    fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
    bold(part = "header") %>%
    border_inner_h(border = fp_border(color="gray80", width = 1)) %>%
    set_caption(
      caption = as_paragraph(
        as_chunk(cap_text, props = fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 12, bold = TRUE))
      ),
      style = "Normal",
      fp_p = fp_par(text.align = "left")
    )
  
  apply_scientific_italics_column(ft, 2)
}
```

```{r summary_render, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Render the Summary Table
if(!is.null(params$data_list) && length(params$data_list) >= 1) {
  render_species_summary(params$data_list[[1]])
}
```

```{r loop_render, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE}
# --- 6. DYNAMIC LOOP FOR ALL SELECTED STRESSORS ---
if(!is.null(params$data_list) && length(params$data_list) >= 2) {
  item_names <- names(params$data_list)
  stressor_indices <- which(item_names != "Outside Selection" & seq_along(item_names) > 1)
  
  for (i in stressor_indices) {
    cat("\n\n\\newpage\n\n")
    cat("# ", clean_stressor_name(item_names[i]), "\n\n")
    ft <- format_st_table(params$data_list[[i]], item_names[i])
    cat(knitr::knit_print(ft))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r others_render, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE}
# --- 7. FINAL TABLE: OUTSIDE SELECTION ---
if("Outside Selection" %in% names(params$data_list)) {
  cat("\n\n\\newpage\n\n")
  cat("# Outside Selection\n\n")
  ft_others <- format_st_table(params$data_list[["Outside Selection"]], "Outside Selection")
  cat(knitr::knit_print(ft_others))
}
```
